how_to_apply: Open the IIT Delhi jobs portal (https://home.iitd.ac.in/jobs-iitd/index.php) and submit the application online.
Fill a separate online application for each academic unit (Department/Centre/School) you apply to; candidates with overlapping interests may be considered for joint appointment if selected.
Complete the application form/data sheet, which is a summary sheet for statutory and statistical data.
Upload a detailed Academic Profile and the supporting documents listed below.
Submit the completed application on or before 31 December 2026, 23:59 PM (IST), and retain a copy.
Log in at https://ecampus.iitd.ac.in/IITDFR-0/login to check whether the application has been received.

Candidates employed in Government and Semi-Government Organizations, Public Undertakings, Universities and Educational Institutions must apply with the consent of their present employers. If forwarding through proper channel will be delayed, they may submit advance copies through the portal with information to the Dean (Faculty), IIT Delhi, or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.

For queries on application submission: Faculty Recruitment Cell (E-I), MS-207/C-18, 2nd Floor, Main Building, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110016, INDIA; Telephone: +91-11-2654-8733; E-mail: [email protected]. Candidates can also contact the Head of the concerned academic unit.
important_instructions: The Institute may call for interview only candidates shortlisted on qualification, experience, research, publication records and the requirements of individual academic units; meeting minimum eligibility gives no right to an interview call. Some units hold a Stage II presentation and faculty interaction; the Department of Material Science & Engineering may seek a brief presentation (5-7 slides, speech embedded) for Stage II shortlisting. An interview call gives no assurance of selection or of acceptance of conditions stated in the application. Outstation interview candidates get to and fro 2-Tier AC Railway fare or economy airfare by the shortest route within India; from abroad, reimbursement is limited to Rs.40,000/- or actual fare, whichever is less. Air tickets should be booked through M/S Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd, M/S Ashoka Travels and Tours or M/S Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all the posts advertised. If any information in the application is found incorrect later, the appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated. No correspondence will be entertained on the reason for not being called for interview or on the interview outcome.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The CEI (RTC) Act (2019) for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS categories and the RPwD Act (2016) for persons with benchmark disabilities apply. The extent of reservation is SC-15%, ST-7.5%, OBC(NCL)-27%, EWS-10% and PwBD-4%. Under Annexure-2, only persons with not less than 40% of relevant disability certified by the Competent Medical Board are eligible for reservation, and an institute-level reservation applies for PwBD with no separate academic unit-wise roster. Women candidates are especially encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates should have specialization in the appropriate area/branch, good communication skills, a commitment to high quality undergraduate and postgraduate education, and demonstrated ability to carry out original and creative research. Ph.D. with 3 years' experience (excluding the experience gained while pursuing Ph.D.) only for Grade I; for Grade II, PhD is the qualifying requirement. First class or equivalent grade in preceding degree in respective discipline, with a consistently good academic record. Demonstrated ability to teach and communicate well. At least 4 refereed conference/journal papers, of which at least 2 should be in reputed journals. Individual academic units may have additional shortlisting criteria, listed below. The Institute may also consider candidates whose specialization lies outside these areas, provided they have an outstanding record. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each academic unit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Grade-I direct recruits start at Academic Pay Level-12, Cell No.1 (₹ 1,01,500). After 3 years as Assistant Professor Grade-I, the incumbent moves to Academic Pay Level-13A1 (₹ 1,31,400 - 2,04,700). Grade-II starts at Academic Pay Level-10, Cell No.8 (₹ 70,900). After one year of experience, the incumbent moves to Academic Pay Level-11; placement in Grade-I depends on meeting experience requirements. Faculty directly recruited into Grade-I and those moving from Grade-II serve a one-year probation. Depending on qualifications and experience, a higher starting salary may be offered in deserving cases as decided by the Selection Committee. Allowances: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance and telephone charges reimbursement as per Institute rules (at present as for Central Government employees stationed in Delhi); LTC, Children Education Allowance and NPS contribution as per GoI rules. Foreign nationals are appointed on contract basis, initially for 5 years, renewable after the 5-year tenure; half time appointments are possible for foreign nationals not on OCI status, and a work visa from the Government of India is needed. One-way economy airfare for the recruit and immediate family, plus relocation allowance up to ₹2,50,000 (from abroad) or ₹1,25,000 (from within India) or actual, whichever is less, subject to serving at least 3 years. "Young Faculty Incentive Fellowship" for 3 years from joining or until movement to Pay Level 13A1, whichever is earlier. Start-up Grant of up to ₹ 20 lakhs for 3 years, and an additional ₹ 30 lakhs matching equipment grant via special project funding from external agencies. Professional Development Allowance of ₹ 3 lakhs per block of 3 years, on reimbursable basis. Eligibility for certain Chair Professor Positions with ₹ 5 lakhs per annum for 3 years, extendable up to 5 years. Transit accommodation initially; leased accommodation outside campus with monthly rental support of up to ₹ 60,500 until regular campus accommodation is provided. Medical insurance for cashless in-patient treatment and free outpatient support at the Institute Hospital; flexible sabbatical leave; professional visits during vacation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The completed online application with supporting documents must be submitted on or before 31 December 2026, 23:59 PM (IST).

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for IIT Delhi Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: A Ph.D., with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree and a consistently good academic record, plus the additional criteria of the academic unit in Annexure-1.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience is needed for Assistant Professor Grade-I and Grade-II?
faq.answer: Grade-I requires at least three years of industrial/research/teaching experience, excluding experience gained before and while pursuing Ph.D.; candidates with less than three years may be considered for Grade-II.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Delhi Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age should be preferably below 35 years; Annexure-1 gives the preferred age as under 35 years for male and 38 years for female candidates, relaxed by 5 years for PwBD, SC and ST and 3 years for OBC-NCL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIT Delhi Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Grade-I is at 7th CPC Pay Level 12 (₹ 1,01,500-1,67,400) with minimum pay ₹ 1,01,500, and Grade-II at Pay Level 10 (₹ 57,700-98,200) with minimum pay ₹ 70,900, plus DA, HRA, Transport Allowance and other benefits.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIT Delhi faculty recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the IIT Delhi jobs portal, upload a detailed Academic Profile and certificates, and check the application status at the ecampus faculty recruitment login.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification, experience, research, publication records and unit requirements, and shortlisted candidates are called for interview; some units also hold a Stage II presentation and faculty interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply to more than one department at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate online application must be filled for each academic unit, and candidates with overlapping interests may be considered for joint appointment if selected.

faq.question: Q9. Are foreign nationals appointed on contract?
faq.answer: Yes, foreign nationals are appointed on contract basis initially for 5 years, renewable after the 5-year tenure, and need a work visa from the Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. Will IIT Delhi pay travel fare for the interview?
faq.answer: Outstation candidates get to and fro 2-Tier AC Railway fare or economy airfare by the shortest route within India; from abroad, reimbursement is limited to Rs.40,000 or the actual fare, whichever is less.
